No secRMM data was found in this Log Analytics workspace.

The secRMM_CL table does not exist yet, or it has no events. Check that:
1. The selected workspace is the one secRMM sends its events to.
2. The secRMM_CL table and data collection rule were created (Microsoft Sentinel: the secRMM data connector page, Deploy secRMM connector resources; otherwise, you can run the secRMM Azure Log Analytics setup script named secRMMAzureLogAnalyticsV2Setup.ps1).
3. secRMM is configured with the connection values (see the secRMM administrator guide, property named SendToAzureLog) and has generated an event, for example by plugging in a USB drive. New data can take a few minutes to appear.
Select a tab. The time range and the Computer and User filters apply to every tab.

content.json: Microsoft Defender activity on removable storage

content.query:
let ExternalEvents = secRMM_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where array_length(dynamic([{Computer}])) == 0 or set_has_element(dynamic([{Computer}]), '*') or Computer in (dynamic([{Computer}]))
| extend Message = coalesce(tostring(column_ifexists('Message_s', '')), tostring(column_ifexists('Message', '')))
| where Event_s == 'EXTERNAL' and Message contains 'Microsoft Defender'
| project ExternalTime = TimeGenerated, Message, Computer;
let OnlineEvents = secRMM_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (({TimeRange:start} - 30d) .. {TimeRange:end})
| where Event_s == 'ONLINE'
| project OnlineTime = TimeGenerated, User = User_s, Computer;
ExternalEvents
| join kind=leftouter OnlineEvents on Computer
| where isnull(OnlineTime) or OnlineTime < ExternalTime
| summarize arg_max(OnlineTime, User) by ExternalTime, Computer, Message
| where array_length(dynamic([{User}])) == 0 or set_has_element(dynamic([{User}]), '*') or User in (dynamic([{User}]))
| project Time = ExternalTime, Computer, User, Message
| order by Time desc

content.json: Removable storage by encryption

content.query:
secRMM_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where array_length(dynamic([{Computer}])) == 0 or set_has_element(dynamic([{Computer}]), '*') or Computer in (dynamic([{Computer}]))
| where array_length(dynamic([{User}])) == 0 or set_has_element(dynamic([{User}]), '*') or User_s in (dynamic([{User}]))
| where isnotempty(SerialNumber_s) and not(SerialNumber_s has_any('CD_DVD','NONE'))
| extend Encryption = case(DeviceDescription_s contains 'Hardware', 'hardware', DeviceDescription_s contains 'BitLocker', 'bitlocker', 'none')
| extend Model = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(Model_s, ''', "'"), '"', '"'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '&', '&')
| extend DeviceDescription = replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(replace_string(DeviceDescription_s, ''', "'"), '"', '"'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '&', '&')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SerialNumber_s, User_s, Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Encryption, SerialNumber = SerialNumber_s, Model, DeviceDescription, Computer, User = User_s, Time = Time_s
| order by Encryption asc, TimeGenerated desc
